<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function system_status(): array
{
    return [
        'name' => SYSTEM_NAME,
        'version' => SYSTEM_VERSION,
        'zeit' => time(),
        'datenbank' => datenbank_ist_verfuegbar(),
        'entwicklung' => ENTWICKLUNGSMODUS,
    ];
}

function system_installationshinweis(): string
{
    return 'Temporaeres Admin-Passwort sowie initiale API- und MCP-Schluessel nach der ersten Anmeldung rotieren.';
}

function system_server_informationen(): array
{
    $speicher = system_speicher_informationen();
    $festplatte = system_festplatten_informationen(PFAD_ROOT);
    $temperatur = system_temperatur_celsius();
    $load = sys_getloadavg() ?: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0];
    $kerne = system_cpu_kerne();
    $load_prozent = system_cpu_auslastung_prozent();

    return [
        'hostname' => gethostname() ?: 'unbekannt',
        'php_version' => PHP_VERSION,
        'server_software' => (string)($_SERVER['SERVER_SOFTWARE'] ?? 'unbekannt'),
        'cpu_kerne' => $kerne,
        'load_1' => (float)$load[0],
        'load_5' => (float)$load[1],
        'load_15' => (float)$load[2],
        'load_prozent' => $load_prozent,
        'ram_gesamt' => $speicher['gesamt'],
        'ram_frei' => $speicher['frei'],
        'ram_genutzt' => $speicher['genutzt'],
        'ram_prozent' => $speicher['prozent'],
        'disk_gesamt' => $festplatte['gesamt'],
        'disk_frei' => $festplatte['frei'],
        'disk_genutzt' => $festplatte['genutzt'],
        'disk_prozent' => $festplatte['prozent'],
        'temperatur_c' => $temperatur,
        'uptime' => system_uptime_sekunden(),
    ];
}

function system_dashboard_profile(): array
{
    system_dashboard_collector_starten();
    $cache = system_dashboard_cache_laden();
    return is_array($cache['profile'] ?? null) && $cache['profile'] !== []
        ? $cache['profile']
        : system_dashboard_leer_profile();
}

function system_dashboard_live_daten(): array
{
    system_dashboard_collector_starten();
    $cache = system_dashboard_cache_laden();
    $serverzeit = microtime(true);
    $erfasst_am = (float)($cache['erfasst_am'] ?? 0);
    return [
        'status' => system_status(),
        'profile' => is_array($cache['profile'] ?? null) && $cache['profile'] !== [] ? $cache['profile'] : system_dashboard_leer_profile(),
        'serverzeit' => $serverzeit,
        'erfasst_am' => $erfasst_am,
        'cache_alter_ms' => $erfasst_am > 0 ? max(0, (int)round(($serverzeit - $erfasst_am) * 1000)) : null,
    ];
}

function system_dashboard_knoten(): array
{
    return [
        'openclaw' => ['key' => 'openclaw', 'name' => 'OpenClaw', 'adresse' => '192.168.178.221', 'rolle' => 'Agent Runtime auf Proxmox'],
        'hermes' => ['key' => 'hermes', 'name' => 'Hermes', 'adresse' => '192.168.178.222', 'rolle' => 'Hermes Dienst / Coder-Node'],
        'webui' => ['key' => 'webui', 'name' => 'WebUI', 'adresse' => '192.168.178.223', 'rolle' => 'Hermclaw Interface auf Unraid'],
        'videoanalyse' => ['key' => 'videoanalyse', 'name' => 'Videoanalyse', 'adresse' => '192.168.178.224', 'rolle' => 'GPU-Worker fuer Teams-Analyse'],
        'localai' => ['key' => 'localai', 'name' => 'Local AI Gateway', 'adresse' => '192.168.178.225', 'rolle' => 'LiteLLM und Agent Runtime'],
    ];
}

function system_dashboard_cache_pfad(): string
{
    return PFAD_LOGS . '/system_metrics_cache.json';
}

function system_dashboard_cache_laden(): array
{
    $pfad = system_dashboard_cache_pfad();
    $inhalt = is_readable($pfad) ? file_get_contents($pfad) : false;
    $daten = is_string($inhalt) ? json_decode($inhalt, true) : null;
    return is_array($daten) ? $daten : [];
}

function system_dashboard_cache_speichern(array $profile, float $erfasst_am): bool
{
    $pfad = system_dashboard_cache_pfad();
    $temp = $pfad . '.tmp.' . getmypid();
    $json = json_encode(['version' => 1, 'erfasst_am' => $erfasst_am, 'profile' => $profile], JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
    if (!is_string($json) || file_put_contents($temp, $json, LOCK_EX) === false) {
        return false;
    }
    @chmod($temp, 0660);
    return @rename($temp, $pfad);
}

function system_dashboard_collector_starten(): void
{
    $skript = PFAD_ROOT . '/scripts/system_metrics_collector.php';
    if (!is_file($skript)) {
        return;
    }
    $bedarf = PFAD_LOGS . '/system_metrics_demand';
    @touch($bedarf);
    $pid_pfad = PFAD_LOGS . '/system_metrics_collector.pid';
    $pid = is_readable($pid_pfad) ? (int)trim((string)file_get_contents($pid_pfad)) : 0;
    if ($pid > 0 && is_dir('/proc/' . $pid)) {
        return;
    }
    $php_cli = is_executable('/usr/bin/php') ? '/usr/bin/php' : PHP_BINARY;
    $befehl = escapeshellarg($php_cli) . ' ' . escapeshellarg($skript) . ' >/dev/null 2>&1 &';
    @exec($befehl);
}

function system_dashboard_leer_profile(): array
{
    $profile = [];
    foreach (system_dashboard_knoten() as $key => $knoten) {
        if ($key === 'webui') {
            $profile[$key] = system_dashboard_webui_profile(system_server_informationen());
            continue;
        }
        $profile[$key] = system_dashboard_remote_profile_fehler($knoten, 'Metriken werden ermittelt');
    }
    return $profile;
}

function system_dashboard_webui_profile(array $webui): array
{
    return [
        'key' => 'webui',
        'name' => 'WebUI',
        'adresse' => '192.168.178.223',
        'rolle' => 'Hermclaw Interface auf Unraid',
        'quelle' => 'Lokaler Telemetry Collector',
        'status' => 'Online',
        'status_typ' => 'erfolg',
        'metriken' => [
            'cpu' => system_dashboard_cpu_metrik($webui),
            'ram' => ['label' => 'RAM-Auslastung', 'wert' => (int)$webui['ram_prozent'], 'text' => system_bytes_formatieren((int)$webui['ram_genutzt']) . ' von ' . system_bytes_formatieren((int)$webui['ram_gesamt']) . ' genutzt'],
            'disk' => system_dashboard_disk_metrik($webui, 'Webroot-Volume'),
        ] + system_dashboard_temperatur_metriken($webui),
        'daten' => [
            'Hostname' => (string)$webui['hostname'],
            'Uptime' => system_dauer_formatieren((int)$webui['uptime']),
            'PHP' => (string)$webui['php_version'],
            'Speicher frei' => system_bytes_formatieren((int)$webui['disk_frei']),
        ],
    ];
}

function system_dashboard_api_verarbeiten(array $eingabe): void
{
    if (!session_angemeldet() || (!rechte_pruefen('dashboard_anzeigen') && !rechte_pruefen('system_verwalten'))) {
        api_antwort(['ok' => false, 'fehler' => 'Nicht berechtigt'], 403);
        return;
    }

    $aktion = validierung_text((string)($eingabe['aktion'] ?? 'status'), 80);
    if ($aktion === 'live_status') {
        csrf_schutz_pruefen();
        api_antwort(['ok' => true, 'daten' => system_dashboard_live_daten()]);
        return;
    }

    api_antwort(['ok' => false, 'fehler' => 'Route nicht gefunden'], 404);
}

function system_remote_dashboard_profile(string $key, string $name, string $adresse, string $rolle): array
{
    $remote = system_remote_metriken_ssh($adresse);
    if ($remote['ok']) {
        return system_dashboard_remote_profile_aus_metriken(['key' => $key, 'name' => $name, 'adresse' => $adresse, 'rolle' => $rolle], $remote);
    }

    $client_profil = system_agent_client_dashboard_profile($key, $name, $adresse, $rolle);
    if ($client_profil !== null) {
        return $client_profil;
    }

    return system_dashboard_remote_profile_fehler(['key' => $key, 'name' => $name, 'adresse' => $adresse, 'rolle' => $rolle], (string)($remote['fehler'] ?? 'Metrik-SSH nicht erreichbar'));
}

function system_dashboard_remote_profile_aus_metriken(array $knoten, array $remote): array
{
    $gpu_erwartet = (string)($knoten['key'] ?? '') === 'videoanalyse';
    return [
        'key' => (string)$knoten['key'],
        'name' => (string)$knoten['name'],
        'adresse' => (string)$knoten['adresse'],
        'rolle' => (string)$knoten['rolle'],
        'quelle' => 'Telemetry Collector · persistente SSH-Verbindung',
        'status' => 'Online',
        'status_typ' => 'erfolg',
        'metriken' => [
            'cpu' => system_dashboard_cpu_metrik($remote),
            'ram' => ['label' => 'RAM-Auslastung', 'wert' => (int)$remote['ram_prozent'], 'text' => system_bytes_formatieren((int)$remote['ram_genutzt']) . ' von ' . system_bytes_formatieren((int)$remote['ram_gesamt']) . ' genutzt'],
            'disk' => system_dashboard_disk_metrik($remote, '/'),
        ] + system_dashboard_temperatur_metriken($remote) + system_dashboard_gpu_metriken($remote, $gpu_erwartet),
        'daten' => [
            'Hostname' => (string)$remote['hostname'],
            'Uptime' => system_dauer_formatieren((int)$remote['uptime']),
            'Kernel' => (string)$remote['kernel'],
            'Speicher frei' => system_bytes_formatieren((int)$remote['disk_frei']),
            'Quelle' => 'metrics@' . (string)$knoten['adresse'],
        ] + system_dashboard_optionale_daten($remote),
    ];
}

function system_dashboard_remote_profile_fehler(array $knoten, string $fehler): array
{
    $metriken = [
        'cpu' => ['label' => 'CPU-Auslastung', 'wert' => 0, 'text' => 'Keine aktuellen Telemetriedaten'],
        'ram' => ['label' => 'RAM-Auslastung', 'wert' => 0, 'text' => 'Keine aktuellen Telemetriedaten'],
        'disk' => ['label' => 'Freier Speicher', 'wert' => 0, 'text' => 'Keine aktuellen Telemetriedaten'],
    ] + system_dashboard_temperatur_metriken([]);
    if ((string)($knoten['key'] ?? '') === 'videoanalyse') {
        $metriken += system_dashboard_gpu_metriken([], true);
    }
    return [
        'key' => (string)$knoten['key'],
        'name' => (string)$knoten['name'],
        'adresse' => (string)$knoten['adresse'],
        'rolle' => (string)$knoten['rolle'],
        'quelle' => 'Telemetry Collector',
        'status' => 'Offline',
        'status_typ' => 'fehler',
        'metriken' => $metriken,
        'daten' => ['Adresse' => (string)$knoten['adresse'], 'Rolle' => (string)$knoten['rolle'], 'Hinweis' => $fehler !== '' ? $fehler : 'Host nicht erreichbar'],
    ];
}

function system_dashboard_cpu_metrik(array $daten): array
{
    $wert = max(0, min(100, (int)($daten['load_prozent'] ?? 0)));
    return [
        'label' => 'CPU-Auslastung',
        'wert' => $wert,
        'text' => $wert . '% aktuell · ' . max(1, (int)($daten['cpu_kerne'] ?? 1)) . ' Kerne · Load ' . number_format((float)($daten['load_1'] ?? 0), 2, ',', '.'),
    ];
}

function system_agent_client_dashboard_profile(string $key, string $name, string $adresse, string $rolle): ?array
{
    if (!function_exists('agenten_clients_array')) {
        return null;
    }

    foreach (agenten_clients_array(200) as $client) {
        $kennung = strtolower(implode(' ', [
            (string)($client['titel'] ?? ''),
            (string)($client['hostname'] ?? ''),
            (string)($client['letzte_ip'] ?? ''),
            (string)($client['beschreibung'] ?? ''),
        ]));
        if (!str_contains($kennung, strtolower($adresse)) && !str_contains($kennung, strtolower($key)) && !str_contains($kennung, strtolower($name))) {
            continue;
        }

        $hardware = system_json_array((string)($client['hardware_json'] ?? '{}'));
        if ($hardware === []) {
            continue;
        }

        return system_dashboard_profile_aus_hardware($key, $name, $adresse, $rolle, $hardware, $client);
    }

    return null;
}

function system_dashboard_profile_aus_hardware(string $key, string $name, string $adresse, string $rolle, array $hardware, array $client): array
{
    $load = is_array($hardware['load'] ?? null) ? $hardware['load'] : [];
    $load_1 = (float)($load['1'] ?? $load[0] ?? 0);
    $load_5 = (float)($load['5'] ?? $load[1] ?? 0);
    $load_15 = (float)($load['15'] ?? $load[2] ?? 0);
    $kerne = max(1, (int)($hardware['cpu_kerne'] ?? $hardware['cores'] ?? 1));

    $ram = is_array($hardware['ram'] ?? null) ? $hardware['ram'] : [];
    $ram_gesamt = (int)($hardware['ram_gesamt'] ?? $ram['MemTotal'] ?? $ram['mem_total'] ?? 0);
    $ram_frei = (int)($hardware['ram_frei'] ?? $hardware['ram_verfuegbar'] ?? $ram['MemAvailable'] ?? $ram['mem_available'] ?? 0);
    $ram_genutzt = max(0, (int)($hardware['ram_genutzt'] ?? ($ram_gesamt - $ram_frei)));
    $ram_prozent = $ram_gesamt > 0 ? (int)round(($ram_genutzt / $ram_gesamt) * 100) : 0;

    $disk_gesamt = (int)($hardware['disk_gesamt'] ?? $hardware['disk_total'] ?? 0);
    $disk_frei = (int)($hardware['disk_frei'] ?? $hardware['disk_free'] ?? 0);
    $disk_genutzt = max(0, (int)($hardware['disk_genutzt'] ?? ($disk_gesamt - $disk_frei)));
    $disk_prozent = $disk_gesamt > 0 ? (int)round(($disk_genutzt / $disk_gesamt) * 100) : 0;

    $remote = [
        'hostname' => (string)($hardware['hostname'] ?? $client['hostname'] ?? $name),
        'kernel' => (string)($hardware['kernel'] ?? ''),
        'uptime' => (int)($hardware['uptime'] ?? 0),
        'cpu_kerne' => $kerne,
        'load_1' => $load_1,
        'load_5' => $load_5,
        'load_15' => $load_15,
        'load_prozent' => min(100, (int)round(($load_1 / $kerne) * 100)),
        'ram_gesamt' => $ram_gesamt,
        'ram_genutzt' => $ram_genutzt,
        'ram_prozent' => $ram_prozent,
        'disk_gesamt' => $disk_gesamt,
        'disk_genutzt' => $disk_genutzt,
        'disk_frei' => $disk_frei,
        'disk_prozent' => $disk_prozent,
        'temperatur_c' => is_numeric($hardware['temperatur_c'] ?? null) ? (float)$hardware['temperatur_c'] : null,
        'gpu_name' => (string)($hardware['gpu']['name'] ?? $hardware['gpu_name'] ?? ''),
        'gpu_auslastung_prozent' => is_numeric($hardware['gpu']['auslastung_prozent'] ?? $hardware['gpu_auslastung_prozent'] ?? null) ? (int)($hardware['gpu']['auslastung_prozent'] ?? $hardware['gpu_auslastung_prozent']) : null,
        'gpu_ram_genutzt' => (int)($hardware['gpu']['ram_genutzt'] ?? $hardware['gpu_ram_genutzt'] ?? 0),
        'gpu_ram_gesamt' => (int)($hardware['gpu']['ram_gesamt'] ?? $hardware['gpu_ram_gesamt'] ?? 0),
        'gpu_ram_prozent' => is_numeric($hardware['gpu']['ram_prozent'] ?? $hardware['gpu_ram_prozent'] ?? null) ? (int)($hardware['gpu']['ram_prozent'] ?? $hardware['gpu_ram_prozent']) : null,
        'gpu_temperatur_c' => is_numeric($hardware['gpu']['temperatur_c'] ?? $hardware['gpu_temperatur_c'] ?? null) ? (float)($hardware['gpu']['temperatur_c'] ?? $hardware['gpu_temperatur_c']) : null,
    ];
    $ai_status = is_array($hardware['ai_status'] ?? null) ? $hardware['ai_status'] : [];
    $ai_metriken = system_dashboard_ai_metriken($ai_status);
    $ai_daten = system_dashboard_ai_daten($ai_status);

    return [
        'key' => $key,
        'name' => $name,
        'adresse' => $adresse,
        'rolle' => $rolle,
        'quelle' => 'Live vom Agenten-Client',
        'status' => (string)($client['status'] ?? '') === 'online' ? 'Online' : 'Offline',
        'status_typ' => (string)($client['status'] ?? '') === 'online' ? 'erfolg' : 'fehler',
        'metriken' => [
            'cpu' => [
                'label' => 'CPU-Auslastung',
                'wert' => (int)$remote['load_prozent'],
                'text' => number_format((float)$remote['load_1'], 2, ',', '.') . ' / ' . (int)$remote['cpu_kerne'] . ' Kerne · 5 min ' . number_format((float)$remote['load_5'], 2, ',', '.'),
            ],
            'ram' => [
                'label' => 'RAM-Auslastung',
                'wert' => (int)$remote['ram_prozent'],
                'text' => $ram_gesamt > 0 ? system_bytes_formatieren($ram_genutzt) . ' von ' . system_bytes_formatieren($ram_gesamt) . ' genutzt' : 'Keine RAM-Daten gemeldet',
            ],
            'disk' => system_dashboard_disk_metrik($remote, '/'),
        ] + system_dashboard_temperatur_metriken($remote) + system_dashboard_gpu_metriken($remote) + $ai_metriken,
        'daten' => [
            'Hostname' => (string)$remote['hostname'],
            'Uptime' => (int)$remote['uptime'] > 0 ? system_dauer_formatieren((int)$remote['uptime']) : 'unbekannt',
            'Kernel' => (string)$remote['kernel'],
            'Speicher frei' => $disk_gesamt > 0 ? system_bytes_formatieren($disk_frei) . ' von ' . system_bytes_formatieren($disk_gesamt) : 'Keine Disk-Daten gemeldet',
            'Quelle' => 'Agenten-Client #' . (int)($client['id'] ?? 0),
        ] + system_dashboard_optionale_daten($remote) + $ai_daten,
    ];
}

function system_dashboard_ai_metriken(array $ai_status): array
{
    if ($ai_status === []) {
        return [];
    }

    $metriken = [];
    $mem_total = (int)($ai_status['host_mem_total_kb'] ?? 0);
    $mem_available = (int)($ai_status['host_mem_available_kb'] ?? 0);
    if ($mem_total > 0) {
        $reserve_prozent = max(0, min(100, (int)round(($mem_available / $mem_total) * 100)));
        $metriken['ai_host_ram'] = [
            'label' => 'Tower2 RAM Reserve',
            'wert' => $reserve_prozent,
            'text' => system_bytes_formatieren($mem_available * 1024) . ' MemAvailable',
        ];
    }

    $swap_total = (int)($ai_status['swap_total_kb'] ?? 0);
    $swap_used = (int)($ai_status['swap_used_kb'] ?? 0);
    if ($swap_total > 0) {
        $metriken['ai_swap'] = [
            'label' => 'Tower2 Swap',
            'wert' => max(0, min(100, (int)round(($swap_used / $swap_total) * 100))),
            'text' => system_bytes_formatieren($swap_used * 1024) . ' von ' . system_bytes_formatieren($swap_total * 1024) . ' genutzt',
        ];
    }

    $lock = (string)($ai_status['heavy_lock'] ?? 'unbekannt');
    $metriken['ai_heavy_lock'] = [
        'label' => 'Heavy Lock',
        'wert' => $lock === 'frei' ? 100 : 0,
        'text' => 'tower2_heavy_llm: ' . $lock,
    ];

    return $metriken;
}

function system_dashboard_ai_daten(array $ai_status): array
{
    if ($ai_status === []) {
        return [];
    }

    $aliases = is_array($ai_status['aliases'] ?? null) ? $ai_status['aliases'] : [];
    $daten = [
        'AI LiteLLM' => !empty($ai_status['litellm_online']) ? 'online' : 'offline',
        'AI Gate' => (string)($ai_status['gate_status'] ?? 'unbekannt'),
        'Heavy Lock' => 'tower2_heavy_llm: ' . (string)($ai_status['heavy_lock'] ?? 'unbekannt'),
        'Host RAM Reserve' => system_bytes_formatieren(((int)($ai_status['host_mem_available_kb'] ?? 0)) * 1024),
        'Host Swap' => system_bytes_formatieren(((int)($ai_status['swap_used_kb'] ?? 0)) * 1024) . ' genutzt',
        'Letzter Host-OOM' => (string)($ai_status['last_host_oom'] ?? 'unbekannt'),
        'Ollama .225 geladen' => system_dashboard_liste_kuerzen($ai_status['ollama_225_loaded'] ?? []),
        'Ollama .222 geladen' => system_dashboard_liste_kuerzen($ai_status['ollama_222_loaded'] ?? []),
    ];

    foreach (['local-general', 'local-coder', 'local-vision', 'local-embedding'] as $alias) {
        if (!is_array($aliases[$alias] ?? null)) {
            continue;
        }
        $eintrag = $aliases[$alias];
        $text = (string)($eintrag['modell'] ?? 'unbekannt') . ' @ ' . (string)($eintrag['backend'] ?? 'unbekannt');
        if (!empty($eintrag['fallback_modell'])) {
            $text .= ' · Fallback ' . (string)$eintrag['fallback_modell'];
        } elseif (!empty($eintrag['fallback'])) {
            $text .= ' · Fallback aktiv';
        }
        $text .= !empty($eintrag['verfuegbar']) ? ' · verfuegbar' : ' · nicht gelistet';
        $daten['Alias ' . $alias] = $text;
    }

    $gruende = is_array($ai_status['gate_reasons'] ?? null) ? $ai_status['gate_reasons'] : [];
    if ($gruende !== []) {
        $daten['WAITING_FOR_RESOURCE'] = implode(', ', array_map('strval', $gruende));
    }

    return $daten;
}

function system_dashboard_liste_kuerzen(mixed $werte): string
{
    if (is_array($werte)) {
        $liste = array_values(array_filter(array_map('strval', $werte), static fn(string $wert): bool => $wert !== ''));
        return $liste !== [] ? implode(', ', array_slice($liste, 0, 4)) : 'keine';
    }
    $text = trim((string)$werte);
    return $text !== '' ? $text : 'keine';
}

function system_json_array(string $json): array
{
    if (function_exists('json_dekodieren')) {
        $daten = json_dekodieren($json, []);
        return is_array($daten) ? $daten : [];
    }
    $daten = json_decode($json, true);
    return is_array($daten) ? $daten : [];
}

function system_remote_metriken_befehl(string $adresse): string
{
    $key_pfad = PFAD_ROOT . '/.private_metrics/hermclaw_metrics.env';
    if (!is_readable($key_pfad)) {
        return '';
    }

$remote_script = <<<'SH'
printf 'hostname=%s\n' "$(hostname)"
printf 'kernel=%s\n' "$(uname -r)"
printf 'uptime=%s\n' "$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)"
printf 'load=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/loadavg)"
printf 'cores=%s\n' "$(nproc 2>/dev/null || grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo)"
read -r _ u1 n1 s1 i1 w1 q1 z1 t1 _ < /proc/stat
sleep 0.2
read -r _ u2 n2 s2 i2 w2 q2 z2 t2 _ < /proc/stat
total1=$((u1+n1+s1+i1+w1+q1+z1+t1)); total2=$((u2+n2+s2+i2+w2+q2+z2+t2)); idle1=$((i1+w1)); idle2=$((i2+w2)); delta=$((total2-total1)); idle_delta=$((idle2-idle1))
if [ "$delta" -gt 0 ]; then awk -v d="$delta" -v i="$idle_delta" 'BEGIN {printf "cpu_percent=%.1f\n", (d-i)*100/d}'; fi
awk '/^MemTotal:/ {print "mem_total=" $2 * 1024} /^MemAvailable:/ {print "mem_available=" $2 * 1024}' /proc/meminfo
df -B1 / | awk 'NR==2 {print "disk_total=" $2 "\ndisk_used=" $3 "\ndisk_free=" $4 "\ndisk_percent=" $5}'
awk 'BEGIN {max=""} {v=$1 / 1000; if (v > 0 && (max == "" || v > max)) max = v} END {if (max != "") printf "temp_c=%.1f\n", max}' /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp 2>/dev/null
if command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total,temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | awk -F, '{gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", $1); gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", $2); gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", $3); gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", $4); gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", $5); print "gpu_name=" $1 "\ngpu_util=" $2 "\ngpu_mem_used_mib=" $3 "\ngpu_mem_total_mib=" $4 "\ngpu_temp_c=" $5}'
fi
SH;

    $ziel = 'metrics@' . preg_replace('/[^0-9a-zA-Z_.:@-]/', '', $adresse);
    return 'timeout 3 ssh'
        . ' -i ' . escapeshellarg($key_pfad)
        . ' -o BatchMode=yes'
        . ' -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new'
        . ' -o UserKnownHostsFile=' . escapeshellarg(dirname($key_pfad) . '/known_hosts')
        . ' -o ConnectTimeout=1'
        . ' -o ConnectionAttempts=1'
        . ' -o ControlMaster=auto'
        . ' -o ControlPersist=30'
        . ' -o ControlPath=/tmp/hermclaw-metrics-%C'
        . ' ' . escapeshellarg($ziel)
        . ' ' . escapeshellarg($remote_script)
        . ' 2>&1';
}

function system_remote_metriken_ssh(string $adresse): array
{
    $cmd = system_remote_metriken_befehl($adresse);
    if ($cmd === '') {
        return ['ok' => false, 'fehler' => 'Metrik-Key nicht lesbar'];
    }

    $ausgabe = shell_exec($cmd);
    if (!is_string($ausgabe) || trim($ausgabe) === '') {
        return ['ok' => false, 'fehler' => 'Keine Metrikdaten'];
    }

    return system_remote_metriken_ausgabe_auswerten($ausgabe);
}

function system_remote_metriken_ausgabe_auswerten(string $ausgabe): array
{

    $werte = [];
    foreach (explode("\n", trim($ausgabe)) as $zeile) {
        if (!str_contains($zeile, '=')) {
            continue;
        }
        [$key, $wert] = explode('=', $zeile, 2);
        $werte[trim($key)] = trim($wert);
    }

    if (empty($werte['hostname']) || empty($werte['load']) || empty($werte['mem_total']) || empty($werte['disk_total'])) {
        $fehler = trim(preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $ausgabe) ?? '');
        return ['ok' => false, 'fehler' => $fehler !== '' ? substr($fehler, 0, 180) : 'Metrikdaten unvollstaendig'];
    }

    $load = preg_split('/\s+/', (string)$werte['load']);
    $kerne = max(1, (int)($werte['cores'] ?? 1));
    $load_1 = (float)($load[0] ?? 0);
    $mem_total = (int)$werte['mem_total'];
    $mem_available = (int)($werte['mem_available'] ?? 0);
    $mem_genutzt = max(0, $mem_total - $mem_available);
    $disk_total = (int)$werte['disk_total'];
    $disk_free = (int)$werte['disk_free'];
    $disk_used = (int)$werte['disk_used'];
    $gpu_mem_total = (int)($werte['gpu_mem_total_mib'] ?? 0);
    $gpu_mem_used = (int)($werte['gpu_mem_used_mib'] ?? 0);

    return [
        'ok' => true,
        'fehler' => '',
        'hostname' => (string)$werte['hostname'],
        'kernel' => (string)($werte['kernel'] ?? ''),
        'uptime' => (int)floor((float)($werte['uptime'] ?? 0)),
        'cpu_kerne' => $kerne,
        'load_1' => $load_1,
        'load_5' => (float)($load[1] ?? 0),
        'load_15' => (float)($load[2] ?? 0),
        'load_prozent' => isset($werte['cpu_percent']) && is_numeric($werte['cpu_percent']) ? max(0, min(100, (int)round((float)$werte['cpu_percent']))) : min(100, (int)round(($load_1 / $kerne) * 100)),
        'ram_gesamt' => $mem_total,
        'ram_genutzt' => $mem_genutzt,
        'ram_prozent' => $mem_total > 0 ? (int)round(($mem_genutzt / $mem_total) * 100) : 0,
        'disk_gesamt' => $disk_total,
        'disk_genutzt' => $disk_used,
        'disk_frei' => $disk_free,
        'disk_prozent' => $disk_total > 0 ? (int)round(($disk_used / $disk_total) * 100) : 0,
        'temperatur_c' => isset($werte['temp_c']) && is_numeric($werte['temp_c']) ? (float)$werte['temp_c'] : null,
        'gpu_name' => (string)($werte['gpu_name'] ?? ''),
        'gpu_auslastung_prozent' => isset($werte['gpu_util']) && is_numeric($werte['gpu_util']) ? max(0, min(100, (int)round((float)$werte['gpu_util']))) : null,
        'gpu_ram_genutzt' => $gpu_mem_used > 0 ? $gpu_mem_used * 1048576 : 0,
        'gpu_ram_gesamt' => $gpu_mem_total > 0 ? $gpu_mem_total * 1048576 : 0,
        'gpu_ram_prozent' => $gpu_mem_total > 0 ? max(0, min(100, (int)round(($gpu_mem_used / $gpu_mem_total) * 100))) : null,
        'gpu_temperatur_c' => isset($werte['gpu_temp_c']) && is_numeric($werte['gpu_temp_c']) ? (float)$werte['gpu_temp_c'] : null,
    ];
}

function system_speicher_informationen(): array
{
    $werte = [];
    $zeilen = is_readable('/proc/meminfo') ? file('/proc/meminfo', FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) : [];

    foreach ($zeilen ?: [] as $zeile) {
        if (preg_match('/^([A-Za-z_()]+):\s+(\d+)/', $zeile, $treffer)) {
            $werte[$treffer[1]] = (int)$treffer[2] * 1024;
        }
    }

    $gesamt = (int)($werte['MemTotal'] ?? 0);
    $frei = (int)($werte['MemAvailable'] ?? ($werte['MemFree'] ?? 0));
    $genutzt = max(0, $gesamt - $frei);

    return [
        'gesamt' => $gesamt,
        'frei' => $frei,
        'genutzt' => $genutzt,
        'prozent' => $gesamt > 0 ? (int)round(($genutzt / $gesamt) * 100) : 0,
    ];
}

function system_festplatten_informationen(string $pfad): array
{

    $frei = (int)(@disk_free_space($pfad) ?: 0);
    $genutzt = max(0, $gesamt - $frei);

    return [
        'gesamt' => $gesamt,
        'frei' => $frei,
        'genutzt' => $genutzt,
        'prozent' => $gesamt > 0 ? (int)round(($genutzt / $gesamt) * 100) : 0,
    ];
}

function system_temperatur_celsius(): ?float
{
    $werte = [];
    foreach (glob('/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp') ?: [] as $pfad) {
        $rohwert = is_readable($pfad) ? trim((string)file_get_contents($pfad)) : '';
        if ($rohwert !== '' && is_numeric($rohwert)) {
            $temperatur = ((float)$rohwert) / 1000;
            if ($temperatur > 0 && $temperatur < 130) {
                $werte[] = $temperatur;
            }
        }
    }

    if ($werte !== []) {
        return max($werte);
    }

    $ausgabe = trim((string)@shell_exec('command -v sensors >/dev/null 2>&1 && sensors 2>/dev/null'));
    if ($ausgabe !== '' && preg_match_all('/\+([0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)?)\s*°?C/u', $ausgabe, $treffer)) {
        foreach ($treffer[1] as $wert) {
            $temperatur = (float)str_replace(',', '.', (string)$wert);
            if ($temperatur > 0 && $temperatur < 130) {
                $werte[] = $temperatur;
            }
        }
    }

    return $werte !== [] ? max($werte) : null;
}

function system_cpu_kerne(): int
{
    $cpuinfo = is_readable('/proc/cpuinfo') ? file_get_contents('/proc/cpuinfo') : '';
    if (!is_string($cpuinfo) || $cpuinfo === '') {
        return 1;
    }

    $anzahl = preg_match_all('/^processor\s*:/m', $cpuinfo);
    return max(1, (int)$anzahl);
}

function system_cpu_auslastung_prozent(): int
{
    $lesen = static function (): ?array {
        $zeile = is_readable('/proc/stat') ? (string)strtok((string)file_get_contents('/proc/stat'), "\n") : '';
        $teile = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($zeile)) ?: [];
        if (($teile[0] ?? '') !== 'cpu' || count($teile) < 5) {
            return null;
        }
        $werte = array_map('intval', array_slice($teile, 1, 8));
        $gesamt = array_sum($werte);
        $idle = (int)($werte[3] ?? 0) + (int)($werte[4] ?? 0);
        return [$gesamt, $idle];
    };

    $start = $lesen();
    if ($start === null) {
        return 0;
    }
    usleep(200000);
    $ende = $lesen();
    if ($ende === null) {
        return 0;
    }
    $delta = $ende[0] - $start[0];
    $idle = $ende[1] - $start[1];
    return $delta > 0 ? max(0, min(100, (int)round((($delta - $idle) / $delta) * 100))) : 0;
}

function system_uptime_sekunden(): int
{
    $inhalt = is_readable('/proc/uptime') ? trim((string)file_get_contents('/proc/uptime')) : '';
    if ($inhalt === '') {
        return 0;
    }

    return (int)floor((float)explode(' ', $inhalt)[0]);
}

function system_bytes_formatieren(int $bytes): string
{
    if ($bytes >= 1073741824) {
        return number_format($bytes / 1073741824, 1, ',', '.') . ' GB';
    }

    if ($bytes >= 1048576) {
        return number_format($bytes / 1048576, 1, ',', '.') . ' MB';
    }

    if ($bytes >= 1024) {
        return number_format($bytes / 1024, 1, ',', '.') . ' KB';
    }

    return number_format($bytes, 0, ',', '.') . ' B';
}

function system_dauer_formatieren(int $sekunden): string
{
    if ($sekunden <= 0) {
        return 'unbekannt';
    }

    $tage = intdiv($sekunden, 86400);
    $stunden = intdiv($sekunden % 86400, 3600);
    $minuten = intdiv($sekunden % 3600, 60);

    if ($tage > 0) {
        return $tage . ' T ' . $stunden . ' h';
    }

    if ($stunden > 0) {
        return $stunden . ' h ' . $minuten . ' min';
    }

    return $minuten . ' min';
}

function system_schema_initialisieren(): bool
{
    $db = datenbank_verbindung();
    if (!$db) {
        return false;
    }

    try {
        $db->query('SELECT 1 FROM benutzer LIMIT 1');
        system_basisdaten_initialisieren($db);
        system_migrationen_ausfuehren($db);
        return true;
    } catch (Throwable $fehler) {
        $schema_pfad = PFAD_ROOT . '/sql/schema.sql';
        $schema = is_file($schema_pfad) ? file_get_contents($schema_pfad) : '';
        if (!is_string($schema) || $schema === '') {
            logs_schreiben('error', 'schema', 'Schema-Datei fehlt');
            return false;
        }

        foreach (system_sql_statements($schema) as $statement) {
            $db->exec($statement);
        }

        logs_schreiben('application', 'schema', 'Datenbankschema initialisiert');
        system_basisdaten_initialisieren($db);
        system_migrationen_ausfuehren($db);
        return true;
    }
}

function system_migrationen_ausfuehren(PDO $db): void
{
    $pfad = PFAD_ROOT . '/sql/migrations';
    foreach (glob($pfad . '/*.sql') ?: [] as $migration) {
        $sql = file_get_contents($migration);
        if (!is_string($sql) || trim($sql) === '') {
            continue;
        }

        $datei = basename($migration);
        $hash = hash('sha256', $sql);
        $schluessel = 'system.migration.' . $datei . '.hash';
        try {
            $abfrage = $db->prepare('SELECT wert FROM einstellungen WHERE benutzer = "system" AND `key` = :schluessel LIMIT 1');
            $abfrage->execute([':schluessel' => $schluessel]);
            if ((string)($abfrage->fetchColumn() ?: '') === $hash) {
                continue;
            }

            foreach (system_sql_statements($sql) as $statement) {
                $db->exec($statement);
            }

            $abfrage = $db->prepare('INSERT INTO einstellungen (benutzer, `key`, wert, datentyp, beschreibung, erstellt_am, geaendert_am) VALUES ("system", :schluessel, :hash, "string", :beschreibung, :erstellt_am, :geaendert_am) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE wert = VALUES(wert), beschreibung = VALUES(beschreibung), geaendert_am = VALUES(geaendert_am)');
            $zeit = time();
            $abfrage->execute([
                ':schluessel' => $schluessel,
                ':hash' => $hash,
                ':beschreibung' => 'Hash der erfolgreich ausgefuehrten Migration ' . $datei,
                ':erstellt_am' => $zeit,
                ':geaendert_am' => $zeit,
            ]);
        } catch (Throwable $fehler) {
            logs_schreiben('error', 'migration', 'Migration konnte nicht ausgefuehrt werden', ['datei' => $datei, 'fehler' => $fehler->getMessage()]);
        }
    }
}

function system_basisdaten_initialisieren(PDO $db): void
{
    try {
        $basisdaten_pfad = PFAD_ROOT . '/sql/basisdaten.sql';
        $basisdaten = is_file($basisdaten_pfad) ? file_get_contents($basisdaten_pfad) : '';
        if (!is_string($basisdaten) || $basisdaten === '') {
            return;
        }

        $hash = hash('sha256', $basisdaten);
        $abfrage = $db->prepare('SELECT wert FROM einstellungen WHERE benutzer = "system" AND `key` = "system.basisdaten_hash" LIMIT 1');
        $abfrage->execute();
        if ((string)($abfrage->fetchColumn() ?: '') === $hash) {
            return;
        }

        foreach (system_sql_statements($basisdaten) as $statement) {
            $db->exec($statement);
        }

        $jetzt = time();
        $abfrage = $db->prepare('INSERT INTO einstellungen (benutzer, `key`, wert, datentyp, beschreibung, erstellt_am, geaendert_am) VALUES ("system", "system.basisdaten_hash", :hash, "string", "Hash der zuletzt importierten Basisdaten", :erstellt_am, :geaendert_am) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE wert = VALUES(wert), geaendert_am = VALUES(geaendert_am)');
        $abfrage->execute([
            'hash' => $hash,
            'erstellt_am' => $jetzt,
            'geaendert_am' => $jetzt,
        ]);
        logs_schreiben('application', 'schema', 'Basisdaten initialisiert');
    } catch (Throwable $fehler) {
        logs_schreiben('error', 'schema', 'Basisdaten konnten nicht initialisiert werden');
    }
}

function system_sql_statements(string $sql): array
{
    $statements = [];
    $statement = '';
    $in_string = false;
    $quote = '';
    $escape = false;
    $length = strlen($sql);

    for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {
        $char = $sql[$i];
        $statement .= $char;

        if ($escape) {
            $escape = false;
            continue;
        }

        if ($in_string && $char === '\\') {
            $escape = true;
            continue;
        }

        if ($char === "'" || $char === '"') {
            if (!$in_string) {
                $in_string = true;
                $quote = $char;
                continue;
            }
            if ($quote === $char) {
                $next = $sql[$i + 1] ?? '';
                if ($next === $char) {
                    $statement .= $next;
                    $i++;
                    continue;
                }
                $in_string = false;
                $quote = '';
            }
            continue;
        }

        if ($char === ';' && !$in_string) {
            $statement = trim(substr($statement, 0, -1));
            if ($statement !== '') {
                $statements[] = $statement;
            }
            $statement = '';
        }
    }

    $statement = trim($statement);
    if ($statement !== '') {
        $statements[] = $statement;
    }

    return $statements;
}
